messages:
alex: Anyone else seeing notify-relay drop pages? PagerDuty incidents not created for a bunch of alerts since 10:22 UTC. Customers might be affected.

opsbot: [ALERT] notify-relay/webhook - 502 Bad Gateway x4 - delivery queue length rising

jen (oncall): I'm booting up — taking this. @mike can you jump if I need handoff?

mike: oncall-backup here, available

jen (oncall): quick check: PagerDuty signing key rotated yesterday — could be an auth reject. running curl to PD endpoint now

jen (oncall): ```
curl -v -H 'X-Signature: ...' -d '{"payload":"..."}' https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue
# response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"invalid signature"}
```

katy: I see 403s in our relay logs too: `notify_relay:pd_send: status=403 body="{"error":"invalid signature"}"` started at 10:21:48 UTC

alex: so signing rotation didn't propagate to dedicated relay instances in eu-west-1? We deployed rotation config at 03:00 and the control-plane rollout skipped some nodes in eu-west

deploy-bot: rollout cluster-notify-relay v2.14 -> partial success, failed nodes: 3/12 in eu-west-1

jen (oncall): workaround: flipping relay to fallback-key1 for PD while we reconcile. Doing a manual key switch; will monitor for new pages

mike: echo: make sure we annotate incident channel and handoff if customers already impacted. I'll call CS to confirm affected accounts

katy: CS confirms 2 customers reported delayed escalations (ACME, BetaCorp). Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NOTIFY-2345

jen (oncall): manual switch done. sending test page now

jen (oncall): opsbot -> test alert triggered, PD incident created successfully (PD-INC-7890)

alex: good. next steps: (1) reconcile missing pages and create followup incidents for each lost page (2) fix rollout process so key rotator syncs across regions (3) post-mortem and customer notification draft

mike: I'll start triage doc and ping legal for notification template

katy: capturing metrics: ~28 pages dropped, peak relay queue 560, avg resend latency 18s. attaching logs to ticket

jen (oncall): handing off to mike for postmortem and followups. I'm good to sign out in 15.

mike: taking it. thanks all. please add any stragglers to the ticket. :thumbsup:

opsbot: [NOTIFICATION] Incident channel #incidents was muted by automation during the cascade — automation rule 'quiet-window' triggered at 10:20 UTC because of rate spike. Recommend disabling quiet-window for notify-relay alerts until fix

alex: note: automation muting worsened customer impact. Add mitigation to the PM — we need safer fail-open for paging muting rules

mike: acknowledged. will include action items in the retro. closing thread for now but keeping ticket open until PM complete.
